Second primary episode, secondary pneumothorax, persistent leak
Recurrence 19 to 29% at 1 year after first primary episode

valueTables.footnote: Harrison states about half of primary spontaneous pneumothoraces recur; Merck gives 19 to 29% at 1 year. The figures differ in follow-up time. Merck does not state intrapleural alteplase or dornase doses.
